planets.name: HD 202772 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 202772 A with a 3.31-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: HD 202772 A b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 202772 A. Its orbit and size follow Jofré et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
